description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to property of Intestate in Meerigama D/S Division,  Gampaha District  and other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically the registration of title for intestate properties under the Registration of Title Act. It contains notices calling for claims to specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions (cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, extents, and locations), which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
